packageName.description: The name of the package being analyzed.

dependencyVersions.description: A map of dependencies for this package alongside their semantic versions.

canonicalTesterCoverage.description: A JSON field containing the canonical tester coverage data.

codeCoverageMetadata.description:
Field containing the code coverage metadata for this package. This information is merged with the code
coverage result when code coverage is run in Jarvis.

fileMetricResults.description: The file-level code analysis metric results.

packageMetricResults.description: The package-level code analysis metric results.

erroredFileMetricResults.description: The errored file-level code analysis metric results.

erroredPackageMetricResults.description: The errored package-level code analysis metric results.

invalidAstErrors.description: The list of errors encountered during AST generation.

packageHealthScore.description:
The package health score and its breakdown for the package.
This json object field is maintained to ensure backward compatibility as teams move from 8.7 to 8.8.

packageDirectives.description:
The map of file paths in the package to the {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.Directive}s
parsed from those files.

codeAnalysisConfig.description:
The name of the config that the result was generated with. This hasn't necessarily
been applied to the result. Use {@link BaseCodeAnalysis#applyConfigToResult} to
apply the config to the result.

processedFileMetricResults.description: The processed file-level code analysis metric results.

processedPackageMetricResults.description: The processed package-level code analysis metric results.

processedInvalidAstErrors.description:
The processed invalid AST file errors. These errors are filtered down to the ones that
were raised on files that were touched in this pull request.

codeCoverageResult.description:
Code coverage results for this package. If code coverage is not run or the code coverage report is missing,
this will be null.

codeCoverage.description: Code coverage results for this package.

title: Code analysis result containing file and package-level code analysis metrics and relevant metadata.
name: BaseCodeAnalysis.Result.Processed
